::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/gateways"}
#docs
Credentials are write-only on the account; this lists only their fields.

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `list`. One of `list`. |
| `data` | `array of object` | The gateways you can connect. |
| `data.object` | `string` | The object type; always `gateway`. One of `gateway`. |
| `data.key` | `string` | The gateway's key, used as `provider` elsewhere in the API. One of `tmtest`, `stripe`, `paypal`, `razorpay`, `gocardless`, `braintree`, `cashfree`, `adyen`, `checkoutcom`, `authorizenet`, `square`, `mollie`, `payu`, `cybersource`. |
| `data.display_name` | `string` | The gateway's display name. |
| `data.note` | `string` | A note about using this gateway. |
| `data.simulated` | `boolean` | Moves no real money. Refused on a live business. |
| `data.available` | `boolean` | You can connect a new account of this gateway. When false, creating an account is refused. Existing accounts of the gateway keep working. |
| `data.unavailable_reason` | `string` | Why the gateway is not available yet. Null when `available` is true. |
| `data.credential_fields` | `array of object` | The credentials this gateway needs when you create a gateway account. |
| `data.method_types` | `array of object` | Values for a gateway account's `method_types`. |
| `data.webhook_secret` | `string` | Who owns the webhook signing secret: the gateway mints it when we register the endpoint (`provider_minted`), we generate it (`shared`), the gateway signs with an API credential the account already holds (`credential`), the operator copies it from the gateway's dashboard (`operator_pasted`), or the gateway sends no webhooks (`none`). One of `provider_minted`, `shared`, `credential`, `operator_pasted`, `none`. |
| `data.webhook_instructions` | `array of string` | Steps to set up the gateway's webhook for this account. |
| `data.webhook_account_id_in_path` | `boolean` | The notification URL carries the account id in the path (`/v1/gateway_webhooks/<gateway>/<account>`), because the gateway refuses a query string. Otherwise it is `/v1/gateway_webhooks/<gateway>?id=<account>`. |
| `data.intent_purposes` | `array of string` | What the gateway can do for a buyer: take a payment now (`payment`), save a payment method (`setup`), or both. A request that needs one is routed only to accounts whose gateway lists it. |
| `data.wallet_domains` | `boolean` | The gateway registers storefront domains for Apple Pay and Google Pay buttons (`POST /v1/businesses/{biz}/gateway_accounts/{gwa}/wallet_domains`). |
| `data.ach_authorization` | `string` | Who takes the payer's ACH debit authorization for `us_bank_account`. `gateway`: the gateway's own form shows it. `ours`: our checkout and portal show the authorization, and the payer accepts it before the bank account is saved. Null: the gateway offers no ACH debit. One of `gateway`, `ours`. |
| `data.currencies` | `array of string` | The currencies a gateway account of this gateway can route (ISO 4217). An account's `currencies` must be on this list, and an account with no list routes only these. A currency the account already has stays. Null: any currency. |
| `data.international_domestic_currency` | `string` | Set when the gateway takes other currencies only after it enables international payments on your account. An account of this gateway then has `international_enabled`: false, it takes only this currency. Null: no such switch. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | OK |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/gateways" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```
